name: 33441 · Deerfield Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33441 (Deerfield Bch) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33441 (Deerfield Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
68% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33441 (Deerfield Bch) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
